gloss: side shoot; axillary bud; lateral bud

definitions.gloss: side shoot; axillary bud; lateral bud
definitions.explanation: A bud or shoot that grows from the angle between a leaf and the stem, rather than at the tip. Gardeners often pinch these off to direct the plant's energy.

examples.japanese: {脇芽|わきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}んだ→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: I pinched off the side shoots.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脇芽|わきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こまめ→こまめ：10325_komame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you regularly remove a tomato's side shoots, the fruit grows bigger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{脇芽|わきめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧くる。
examples.english: When you cut the main branch, new side shoots grow out from below it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧ (side) + ⟦{芽|め}→芽：02141_me⟧ (bud). A gardening and botany term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脇芽|わきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧ / ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to pinch off side shoots
- {脇芽|わきめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ / ⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: side shoots emerge / grow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新芽|しんめ}→新芽：13028_shinme⟧: new shoot — any fresh bud, not specifically a lateral one
- {頂芽|ちょうが}: terminal bud — the bud at the very tip of a stem
